nom: SkinSmart Antimicrobial Facial Cleanser for Breakouts and Blemishes

segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin (oily T-zone) used it to clear fungal acne caused by sweat under a hardhat and reports her skin cleared within about a week.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea, eczema or lupus, report no stinging, dryness or redness and calmer, clearer skin; a smaller but consistent group instead reports the opposite — dryness, itching, redness or a compromised skin barrier, in some cases severe enough to stop using it.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the spray does not dry out their skin and even helps calm dryness caused by other products; a few instead report it dried their skin, caused itching, or left it feeling tight, with one needing to follow up with moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report reduced redness and calmer skin, including with rosacea; others report the opposite — new redness, irritation or itchy red bumps, in one case severe enough that the reviewer describes her skin barrier as compromised.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the spray compromised her skin barrier, causing significant redness and irritation despite following storage instructions correctly.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, many with long-standing or hormonal acne, workout-related breakouts, mask-related ("maskne") acne, or fungal acne, report fewer and less severe breakouts, sometimes within days; a minority report no effect or, in a few cases, a worse breakout than usual after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: Material is limited: one reviewer with combination, T-zone-oily skin says it helped clear breakouts there, and another comparing it to a competitor product found it absorbs some oil but less noticeably than that alternative.

aspects.libelle: Pool or bleach-like smell when first sprayed
Cheaper, larger dupe of pricier HOCl sprays
Leaves no residue, dries fast, lightweight mist
Bottle or sprayer arrives leaking or damaged
Can be sprayed over makeup without disturbing it

extraits.texte: The WORST hypochlorous acid spray ever. I did everything right: I kept it in a cool dry place away from sunlight, I did not overuse it. And it completely compromised my skin barrier. I uploaded a photo of all the redness and irritation. I bought this because an influencer who says she has sensitive skin recommended it. It took so long for me to figure out this product was the culprit of all of my irritation that it’s too late to return it.

extraits.titre: Perfect for my acne prone sensitive skin
extraits.texte: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ This product has been a game changer for my skin. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin and was looking for something gentle that would help with breakouts without drying me out or causing irritation, and this has been amazing. The spray is super easy to use and feels refreshing on the skin. I’ve been using it after workouts, before skincare, and anytime my skin feels irritated or congested. Within a couple weeks I noticed fewer breakouts, less redness, and my skin overall looked calmer and healthier. What I love most is how gentle the hypochlorous acid formula is. It doesn’t sting, leave residue, or make my skin feel tight like harsher acne products often do. It’s also been great for hormonal breakouts and helping my pores look cleaner. I appreciate that it works for all skin types and ages, and the large bottle lasts a long time. Definitely one of those products I didn’t expect to love this much but now use every single day!

extraits.titre: SAFE FOR SENSITIVE SKIN GIRLS! (and guys too :D)
extraits.texte: I recently had the misfortune of experiencing an allergic reaction to one of my toners, which left my face in a dire state – red, irritated, and incredibly dry. Desperate for relief, I stumbled upon this remarkable antibacterial spray, and I couldn't be more thrilled with the results. In just two weeks of consistent use, this product worked wonders in alleviating my skin concerns. The redness and irritation visibly subsided, and my skin's dryness significantly improved. Not only am I happy with the results, but my skin is also radiating with contentment. One thing worth noting is the product's slight bleach-like scent. While it's there, it's by no means overpowering or unbearable, making it suitable for those with sensitive skin, like myself. In summary, this antibacterial spray has been a game-changer for my skin, rescuing it from the aftermath of an allergic reaction. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking effective relief for skin irritations and dryness. It's a savior for sensitive skin individuals like me!

I’ve used this product for one day, ONE DAY, and I have already seen an improvement. I have a lovely combination of hormonal acne, eczema, rosacea, and self-diagnosed perioral dermatitis. I’ve had a horrible flaky rash on the lower portion of my face (pod), and nothing has worked. This spray is a life-saver in disguise. I’ll update if anything changes! No stinging, no weird ingredients, no steroids, and it smells like a swimming pool (which I’ve always kind of liked!) It can make the skin feel a little tight, so I use moisturizer right after spraying if I feel I need it. Edit April 23rd: Still my favorite. My skin no longer gets tight when I spray, so I think my skin has adjusted. My skin feels wonderful and my breakouts have diminished so much. I still love this , and I will continue to buy. I use this and vaseline (on my lips). Nothing else. My skin has never been better.

5/5 product for me! I love this. I work a blue collar job where I have to wear a hardhat for 12 hours and all the sweat on my head/forehead was causing fungal acne not only do I spray my face in the middle of my shift but I also spray my hard hat a couple times throughout my shift and in literally just 1 week of using it it cleared my skin up so much. I have combo skin (oily on my T zone). This is definitely a staple for me now. Btw this product has a ‘bleach’ like scent if you’re sensitive to smells it goes away after a few minutes. Doesn’t leave a sticky feeling afterwards.

THE BEST FACIAL MIST EVER!!! Coming from someone with highly sensitive skin with rosacea and cutaneous lupus- I’m always breaking out with new products. This is so gentle. Just a spray on the face in the morning and then I wash my face. Sometimes I’ll just spray it in the middle of the day. I feel like it helps the breakouts not happen as much either. And it’s lasted forever.

extraits.titre: The only hypochlorous acid spray that doesn’t break me out!
extraits.texte: Tower 28 dupe! Great for after workout to avoid the sweat causing a breakout! I use it twice a day after washing my face! Gives a nice feel on my skin and not irritating . I have VERY sensitive and acne prone skin and it does not bother me! I tried magic molecule and another brand but they broke me out! This one is the BEST .
